title: SieveScript/query response
description: Response from SieveScript/query (RFC 9661). canCalculateChanges is always false: SieveScript/queryChanges is not offered.

accountId.description: The account the query ran against.

queryState.description: Opaque state string for the SieveScript query.

canCalculateChanges.description: Always false: SieveScript/queryChanges is not offered.

position.description: 0-based index of the first id in the ids array.

ids.description: The matching SieveScript ids in the requested order.

total.description: Total number of matching scripts. Only present if calculateTotal was true.

limit.description: The limit applied. Only present if a limit was applied.
